def factor_crash_tail_risk_volume(df):
    """Crash precursor based on extreme negative returns with high volume."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    tail_return = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=20).min()
    vol_mean = df_copy["volume"].rolling(50, min_periods=50).mean()
    vol_ratio = df_copy["volume"] / vol_mean.replace(0, np.nan)
    vol_ratio = vol_ratio.clip(0.5, 2.0)
    factor = -tail_return * vol_ratio
    df_copy["factor_crash_tail_risk_volume"] = factor.fillna(0)
    return df_copy["factor_crash_tail_risk_volume"]
description: Stocks experiencing the largest negative daily return over the past 20 days, especially when accompanied by elevated trading volume, are more prone to crash continuation.
